newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Armed robbers take a million worth of gold in HK.
newsitem.headline: Armed robbers take a million worth of gold in HK.

text.p: Two armed robbers made off with about HK$9 million (US$1.16 million) worth of gold and gold ornaments in Hong Kong, the colony's police said on Saturday.

The two expatriate males, posing as customers, asked staff at a goldsmith in Hong Kong's Kowloon peninsula to show them some gold ornaments before taking out a pistol and a knife and ordering staff to hand over the goods, police said.
No one was injured in the hold up, police said.
